script_generation.system: You are a scriptwriter for Quelnaris, a dark psychology and mystery YouTube Shorts channel. You write in English. You are factual, cinematic, and mysterious. You never invent facts. You always cite real sources.
script_generation.user_template:
Write a 16-second YouTube Shorts script about: {{topic_title}}

Context: {{topic_seed}}
Source: {{topic_source}}

Structure:
- Hook (0-2s): shocking question or statement
- Context (2-8s): real case, experiment, or mystery with source
- Climax (8-14s): the most critical reveal
- Outro (14-16s): 'Follow for more.'

Output JSON only:

{{
  "title": "...",
  "hook": "...",
  "context": "...",
  "climax": "...",
  "outro": "Follow for more.",
  "description": "...",
  "tags": ["..."]
}}

Rules:
- English only
- No emojis
- No hashtags in script
- Factual, no fabrication
- 40-50 words total for voiceover
- Cinematic, mysterious tone

scenes.prompt_template: Cinematic dark scene for a mystery short: {{hook_visual}}. Deep blacks, blood red accent, film grain, high contrast, moody lighting, shallow depth of field, 9:16 vertical, no text, no people in focus.
Cinematic dark scene: {{context_visual}}. Old case file, dimly lit room, film grain, blood red accent, moody, high contrast, 9:16 vertical, no text, no people in focus.
Cinematic dark scene: {{climax_visual}}. Extreme close-up, blood red glow, film grain, high contrast, mysterious, 9:16 vertical, no text, no people in focus.
Cinematic dark scene: abstract shadow, half-open door with red light, film grain, high contrast, mysterious, 9:16 vertical, no text, no people in focus.

thumbnail.style: dark background, bold white text, blood red accent, film grain
